recent_context.fact: Tidepath matched 42 kids with volunteer mentors this quarter, its largest fall match yet.
Tidepath volunteers packed 1,150 weekend meal bags for 96 families in October.
Students in Tidepath's after-school reading club gained an average of 1.4 grade levels in reading over the past school year.
Tidepath trained 28 new volunteer mentors at its October mentor academy in Little Haiti.
Tidepath's back-to-school drive sent 310 kids to the first day of school with a full backpack and supplies.
Tidepath's six-week summer program served 120 kids with swim lessons, museum trips and daily reading time.
Tidepath family coaches helped 64 parents set up budgets, apply for rent help or enroll in classes this year.
Tidepath mentors meet their kids every week for at least a year, and 87% of last year's matches stayed together the full year.
Nineteen local businesses and firms support Tidepath with grants, volunteer hours and in-kind help.
Tidepath's homework help nights run four evenings a week at two Miami library branches.
